summary: Generates and advances combinatorial permutations of a dimension set. Computes the smallest factorial that meets the target count (this+0x54), reports error 55 through the object vtable if the base (this+0x64) is below 2, fills the permutation state array, then advances positions in mixed-radix fashion until the total exceeds the target. In mode 2 (this+0x28 == 2) indices are remapped through global dword_5B06C8.

operations.description: Grow base v4 and factorial v5 until factorial exceeds target count this+0x54.
If minimumBase v7 < 2, take the error path through the object vtable.
Indirect call through object vtable pointer *a1 (this+0x0 / obj+0x0) passing a1.
Fill permutation state array a2 with minimumBase using memset32 for dimensionCount entries.
Compute accumulator v15 = minimumBase^dimensionCount via repeated multiplication loop.
If mode a1[10] (this+0x28) == 2, remap index through global lookup table dword_5B06C8.
Read remap value dword_5B06C8[index] for the permutation index.
Advance positions: increment current base, recompute accumulator as product, and stop when accumulator exceeds target count this+0x54 or all dimensionCount positions are exhausted.
Repeat the advance loop until no position changed (changedFlag unset) or dimensionCount <= 0.
